definition: to let something trail along a surface as you move
description: A paraglider under a red and white wing flies along a grey rock face above a thick pine forest in the mountains. He comes down over a still turquoise lake and pulls his feet through the water, cutting a long white line of spray across the surface, with the whole red wing mirrored in the lake beneath him. He lifts away again, flies over the shore and drops onto a green meadow, where the wing sinks down behind him and a group of people sit at the edge of the grass watching.

de.answer: Er lässt die Füße durch das Wasser schleifen.
de.question: Was macht der Pilot?
